shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a yellow shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat and asks to hear the account of the case, a man in a purple shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat, and a man in a red shirt sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt and the man in a purple shirt exchange seats, and he agrees to retell every detail of the case.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a purple shirt describes the preliminary evidence.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the entrance-side window seat.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt asks about the subsequent events.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the worktable.
